# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] I identified the ontological state(s): resource / potential / capacity / puissance / power relation / effect / return.
- [ ] I identified the dynamic(s): formation / mobilization / composition / conversion / returns / capture / evolution / etc.
- [ ] I identified the relevant domain(s).
- [ ] Source-derived claims include source IDs or technical evidence.
- [ ] New concepts are labeled `NEW-CONCEPT`.
- [ ] I did not silently reconcile conflicting sources.
- [ ] I did not collapse competence, ethics, credibility, legitimacy, or quality into false precision.
- [ ] I considered verification, contestation, substitution, exit, and branch mobility where relevant.
